info.text:
Social Security's yearly raise comes from just 3 months of prices.

The rule: average CPI-W for July, August and September, compare it with the last year there was a raise, round to 0.1%.
In 2025 that average was 317.265 vs 308.729 in 2024, a 2.8% raise paid from January 2026.
The average retired worker went from $2,015 to $2,071 a month.
No raise at all in 2010, 2011 and 2016. September 2026 CPI is scheduled for October 14, 2026.

Sources: SSA Office of the Chief Actuary, SSA 2026 COLA Fact Sheet, CRS, BLS.
News and education, not financial advice.
